signature.name: Marina Bay Sands
signature.detail: Singapore's most recognisable modern icon, with its ship-shaped SkyPark and sweeping views over the bay. Come around sunset for the best light and to catch the evening light show; book SkyPark tickets online in advance.

signature.name: Gardens by the Bay
signature.detail: A futuristic garden with the Supertree Grove and giant glass conservatories that is a must-see for first-timers. Visit in the late afternoon and stay for the free evening Supertree light show; buy conservatory tickets ahead.

signature.name: Merlion Park
signature.detail: The half-lion, half-fish Merlion is the city's emblem and the classic photo spot facing Marina Bay. Go early morning or evening to avoid the heat and crowds; it is free and an easy walk from Raffles Place MRT.

signature.name: Jewel Changi Airport
signature.detail: Home to the Rain Vortex, the world's tallest indoor waterfall, set in a lush indoor garden. It is free to enter the mall; arrive outside peak hours for clearer views and photos.

signature.name: Chinatown Heritage District
signature.detail: Historic shophouse streets packed with temples, markets and food, ideal for a first taste of old Singapore. Wander early in the day, dress respectfully at temples, and reach it easily by Chinatown MRT.

signature.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
signature.detail: A striking Buddhist temple in the heart of Chinatown housing a revered relic and peaceful halls. Entry is free; wear modest clothing covering shoulders and knees, and avoid peak prayer times.

signature.name: Kampong Glam & Haji Lane
signature.detail: Colourful heritage streets around the Sultan Mosque, with boutiques and cafes along Haji Lane. Visit in the morning for cooler weather and quieter lanes; the area is a short walk from Bugis MRT.

signature.name: Little India
signature.detail: A vibrant neighbourhood of temples, markets and Indian food that feels like another world. Go on a weekday and dress modestly at Sri Mariamman Temple; reach it via Little India MRT.

signature.name: Universal Studios Singapore
signature.detail: The island's flagship theme park with rides and shows for all ages. Buy tickets online, arrive at opening, and take the Sentosa Express to reach it.
